scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w frontend && npm run build -w backend
scripts.format: prettier --write backend/src backend/test frontend/src frontend/*.json frontend/*.ts frontend/index.html package.json README.md docs .prettierrc.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check backend/src backend/test frontend/src frontend/*.json frontend/*.ts frontend/index.html package.json README.md docs .prettierrc.json
